channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Will serve mobility needs for years: Singla on first extradosed bridge in Northeast
item.description: SPS Construction India director Rohit Singla said the Rs 3,000-Cr Kumar Bhaskar Varma Bridge is expected to reduce travel time

item.title: Tarique Rahman set to be PM as BNP secures landslide win in Bangladesh elections
item.description: The Awami League party of Hasina was barred from contesting the polls, which recorded 59.44 per cent voter turnout

item.title: Gauhati HC clears Rs 500 Cr Kamakhya corridor project, cites no risk to shrine
item.description: The project is being planned in an area of around 15,000 sq meters atop the Nilachal hills to provide access to one of the most revered shrines

item.title: Assam State Film Awards 2020–21 announced, Balconit Bhogowan bags best film
item.description: In the short film category, Kumu by Akansha Bhagawati received the Nip Barua Award for 2020, and Xogun by Utpal Barpujari secured the award for 2021

item.title: Electrocution kills over 200 elephants in 25 years, illegal fence top threat in Assam
item.description: Tamulpur emerges as hotspot for elephant electrocution deaths where herds of 50–60 routinely move through traditional corridors

item.title: Supreme Court seeks CBI status report on Manipur violence cases in two weeks
item.description: It also asked the Central and Manipur govts to ensure implementation of the recommendations of Justice Gita Mittal committee on rehabilitation of victims

item.title: Meghalaya DGP directs SIT probe into Thangsko Mine Blast
item.description: SIT will conduct a criminal investigation into the 60 illegal coal mining cases in East Jaintia Hills district including Thangsko explosion

item.title: Bharalu River reduced to sewage channel amid years of neglect
item.description: The tragedy of the Bharalu lies not only in how polluted it has become, but in how casually this decline has been accepted

item.title: PM Modi inaugurates NE’s first emergency landing facility in Assam’s Moran
item.description: Arriving aboard an IAF C-130J aircraft from the Chabua airbase, PM Modi witnessed precision drills by Sukhoi-30 MKI, Rafale & ALHs

item.title: PM Modi Makes Historic Landing at Northeast’s First Emergency Landing Facility in Dibrugarh
item.description: PM Modi Makes Historic Landing at Northeast’s First Emergency Landing Facility in Dibrugarh
